sources.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Introduced few-shot chain-of-thought prompting and showed large gains on arithmetic/symbolic/common-sense reasoning for sufficiently capable models.
sources.limits: Older model regime; current reasoning models may not benefit from explicit CoT prompts.

sources.title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Samples multiple reasoning paths and aggregates answers; strong original gains on reasoning benchmarks.
sources.limits: Multiplies inference cost; depends on answer aggregation and diversity.

sources.title: Tree of Thoughts
sources.evidence_notes: Searches over intermediate thought states rather than committing to one chain.
sources.limits: Expensive; evaluator/search quality can dominate.

sources.title: Least-to-Most Prompting
sources.evidence_notes: Decomposes a hard problem into easier subproblems solved sequentially.
sources.limits: Can propagate early decomposition errors.

sources.title: Plan-and-Solve Prompting
sources.evidence_notes: Separates plan generation from execution to reduce missing-step errors.
sources.limits: Task/model dependent.

sources.title: PAL: Program-Aided Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Delegates symbolic/arithmetic execution to a program interpreter.
sources.limits: Requires safe execution and correct program generation.

sources.title: Program of Thoughts Prompting
sources.evidence_notes: Separates reasoning from computation using generated programs.
sources.limits: Sandboxing and verifier needed.

sources.title: ReAct
sources.evidence_notes: Interleaves reasoning, actions, and observations for grounded interactive tasks.
sources.limits: Long loops can be costly and error-prone.

sources.title: Reflexion
sources.evidence_notes: Uses feedback and episodic verbal reflection to improve later attempts.
sources.limits: Benefits depend on useful external/task feedback; reflection alone is not proof.

sources.title: Self-Refine
sources.evidence_notes: Same model generates, critiques, and revises outputs iteratively.
sources.limits: Critical literature shows intrinsic self-correction can also worsen outputs.

sources.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
sources.evidence_notes: Shows prompted self-correction without reliable external feedback can degrade reasoning.
sources.limits: Result is task/model specific but important counterevidence.

sources.title: When Can LLMs Actually Correct Their Own Mistakes?
sources.evidence_notes: Critical survey distinguishing intrinsic self-correction from correction with reliable external feedback.
sources.limits: Broad literature synthesis rather than a single universal bound.

sources.title: DSPy
sources.evidence_notes: Treats LM pipelines declaratively and compiles prompts/demonstrations against metrics.
sources.limits: Optimization can overfit weak metrics.

sources.title: Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO)
sources.evidence_notes: Uses an LLM to generate candidate solutions/prompts and objective feedback to iteratively optimize.
sources.limits: Needs trustworthy objective and holdout.

sources.title: Automatic Prompt Engineer
sources.evidence_notes: Generates and selects candidate instructions automatically.
sources.limits: Search cost and benchmark overfit risk.

sources.title: PromptBreeder
sources.evidence_notes: Evolves task prompts and prompt-mutation prompts.
sources.limits: Can be computationally expensive and overfit task sets.

sources.title: ProTeGi
sources.evidence_notes: Uses natural-language critiques as textual gradients with beam/bandit search.
sources.limits: Requires representative dev set and reliable evaluator.

sources.title: TextGrad
sources.evidence_notes: Backpropagation-like textual feedback across LM pipelines.
sources.limits: Early research; evaluator dependence.

sources.title: OpenAI Reasoning Best Practices
sources.evidence_notes: Current guidance says reasoning models generally benefit from simple/direct goals, constraints, and success criteria; explicit think-step-by-step prompts may hinder.
sources.limits: Provider/model-specific and subject to change.

sources.title: OpenAI Prompting Guide
sources.evidence_notes: Treat prompts as application code: version, test, review, and roll back.
sources.limits: Provider-specific examples.

sources.title: OpenAI Prompt Caching
sources.evidence_notes: Shared stable prefixes can reuse KV work and reduce latency/input cost.
sources.limits: Cache behavior/provider pricing change over time.

sources.title: OpenAI Latency Optimization
sources.evidence_notes: Seven principles include fewer tokens, fewer requests, parallelism, streaming, and not defaulting to an LLM.
sources.limits: Production guidance, not task-quality evidence.

sources.title: OpenAI Structured Outputs
sources.evidence_notes: Schema-constrained outputs improve type/shape reliability and reduce formatting retries.
sources.limits: Supported JSON Schema subset and provider-specific availability.

sources.title: Anthropic Context Engineering
sources.evidence_notes: Treat context as finite and optimize utility; use just-in-time context and lightweight references.
sources.limits: Vendor engineering guidance.

sources.title: Anthropic Writing Effective Tools for Agents
sources.evidence_notes: Tool naming, narrow boundaries, high-signal responses, pagination/filtering, and eval-driven tool descriptions materially affect tool use.
sources.limits: Effects can vary by model.

sources.title: Anthropic Contextual Retrieval
sources.evidence_notes: Combines contextualized chunks, BM25, embeddings, and reranking; reported substantial retrieval-failure reductions.
sources.limits: Vendor experiments and corpus-dependent.

sources.title: Lost in the Middle
sources.evidence_notes: Long-context models can show U-shaped positional sensitivity; relevant information in the middle may be used less effectively.
sources.limits: Performance evolves with newer models; must re-test.

sources.title: LLMLingua
sources.evidence_notes: Learned prompt compression reported large token reductions while preserving task performance in original settings.
sources.limits: Compression can discard hidden constraints; requires task eval.

sources.title: HyDE
sources.evidence_notes: Generates a hypothetical relevant document and embeds it for zero-shot dense retrieval.
sources.limits: Generated assumptions can bias retrieval.

sources.title: Self-RAG
sources.evidence_notes: Trains model to decide when to retrieve and critique relevance/support/utility.
sources.limits: Training-dependent; not a simple runtime prompt.

sources.title: ColBERTv2
sources.evidence_notes: Token-level late interaction improves fine-grained neural retrieval while retaining precomputable document embeddings.
sources.limits: Index/storage and serving complexity.

sources.title: Microsoft GraphRAG
sources.evidence_notes: Graph/community summaries target global corpus sensemaking and relationship-heavy queries.
sources.limits: Expensive indexing and maintenance; often unnecessary for local lookup.

sources.title: RAGAS
sources.evidence_notes: Reference-free RAG metrics for retrieval and faithfulness diagnostics.
sources.limits: Metric/model-judge validity must be calibrated.

sources.title: RAGChecker
sources.evidence_notes: Fine-grained diagnostic framework separating retrieval and generation failure modes.
sources.limits: Evaluation metrics remain proxies for user success.

sources.title: MemGPT
sources.evidence_notes: Virtual-memory metaphor: page information between limited context and external memory tiers.
sources.limits: Architecture is a conceptual reference, not necessarily optimal today.

sources.title: LongMemEval
sources.evidence_notes: Evaluates extraction, cross-session/temporal reasoning, updates, and abstention for long-term assistant memory.
sources.limits: Benchmark distribution differs from personal Agent OS.

sources.title: MemBench
sources.evidence_notes: Evaluates memory effectiveness, efficiency and capacity across multiple memory scenarios.
sources.limits: Recent benchmark; needs local replication.

sources.title: Human-Inspired Memory Architecture for LLM Agents
sources.evidence_notes: Explores consolidation, interference-based forgetting, maturation, reconsolidation, entity graphs and hybrid retrieval; reports strong compression/retention results.
sources.limits: 2026 research; reproduction/generalization needed.

sources.title: PlugMem
sources.evidence_notes: Transforms histories into facts and reusable skills in structured memory.
sources.limits: Recent research; architecture complexity must be justified.

sources.title: MemoryBank
sources.evidence_notes: Uses forgetting-curve-inspired memory decay/reinforcement for long-term conversation.
sources.limits: Biological analogy does not itself validate personal-memory policy.

sources.title: A-MEM
sources.evidence_notes: Zettelkasten-inspired dynamically linked/evolving agent memories.
sources.limits: Recent research; risk of memory graph growth and inference errors.

sources.title: LightMem
sources.evidence_notes: LightMem separates STM/MTM/LTM, online retrieval from offline consolidation, and reports efficiency plus LoCoMo gains.
sources.limits: Recent 2026 paper; benchmark/model dependence still needs Agent OS replication.

sources.title: Generative Agents
sources.evidence_notes: Observation-memory, reflection and planning architecture for believable long-horizon simulated agents.
sources.limits: Simulation/social-agent result, not proof for productivity agents.

sources.title: Toolformer
sources.evidence_notes: Self-supervised training to decide which APIs to call, when, and with what arguments.
sources.limits: Requires training; APIs/tasks limited in original work.

sources.title: ART: Automatic Multi-step Reasoning and Tool-use
sources.evidence_notes: Automatically constructs task programs from demonstrations and tool libraries.
sources.limits: Library quality and execution safety matter.

sources.title: MRKL Systems
sources.evidence_notes: Routes natural-language problems to modular symbolic/neural experts.
sources.limits: Router errors and module interface design are key.

sources.title: ReWOO
sources.evidence_notes: Separates planning from observations to reduce repeated token use compared with ReAct-style loops.
sources.limits: Less adaptive when observations should change the plan.

sources.title: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard
sources.evidence_notes: Benchmarks function/tool calling including parallel, multiple, and stateful cases.
sources.limits: Leaderboard task mix may not match Agent OS.

sources.title: SWE-bench
sources.evidence_notes: Real GitHub issue resolution benchmark with execution-based verification.
sources.limits: Benchmark contamination and repository subset limitations.

sources.title: SWE-agent Agent-Computer Interfaces
sources.evidence_notes: Shows that the agent-computer interface itself materially affects coding-agent performance.
sources.limits: Specific to software engineering, but broadly relevant to tool UX.

sources.title: BrowseComp
sources.evidence_notes: Hard web-browsing benchmark with short verifiable answers; test-time sampling can improve coverage.
sources.limits: Designed benchmark, not user workload.

sources.title: Anthropic Demystifying Evals for AI Agents
sources.evidence_notes: Advocates multi-turn/state/environment evaluation and combining grading techniques.
sources.limits: Vendor guidance.

sources.title: OpenAI Evaluation Best Practices
sources.evidence_notes: Continuous evals, representative data, pairwise/pass-fail grading, human calibration and explicit rubrics.
sources.limits: OpenAI-hosted Evals platform itself is being deprecated.

sources.title: Judging the Judges: Position Bias
sources.evidence_notes: 150k+ evaluations show systematic position bias varying by judge/task.
sources.limits: Focuses one bias class; other evaluator biases also matter.

sources.title: Multi-Agent Judge Bias Amplification
sources.evidence_notes: Finds some multi-agent debate judge setups can amplify biases rather than cancel them.
sources.limits: Specific frameworks/tasks.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions
sources.evidence_notes: Defines evolving spans/metrics/events for inference, retrieval, memory, tools, plans and agents.
sources.limits: Some agent conventions are still development status.

sources.title: Google SRE Canarying Releases
sources.evidence_notes: Limit blast radius and consume only a bounded fraction of error budget while measuring candidate behavior.
sources.limits: General systems practice; needs adaptation to agent behavior.

sources.title: DPO
sources.evidence_notes: Simplifies preference alignment to classification-like objective without PPO/reward-model loop.
sources.limits: Later work identifies tradeoffs and no universally best preference loss.

sources.title: KTO
sources.evidence_notes: Uses desirable/undesirable binary feedback and prospect-theoretic utility; reports competitive preference alignment.
sources.limits: Best inductive bias depends on setting.

sources.title: SimPO
sources.evidence_notes: Reference-free preference optimization using average sequence log-probability reward.
sources.limits: Preference optimization remains dataset/eval sensitive.

sources.title: Constitutional AI
sources.evidence_notes: Principles guide critique/revision and AI-generated preference feedback.
sources.limits: Constitution choice and evaluator failure remain governance issues.

sources.title: RLAIF vs RLHF
sources.evidence_notes: Reports AI-feedback alignment comparable to RLHF on studied tasks, with human evaluation of final policies.
sources.limits: Reward-model validation alone was imperfect; final policy must be evaluated.

sources.title: InstructGPT / RLHF
sources.evidence_notes: SFT + human preference reward model + PPO improved instruction following and human preference.
sources.limits: Expensive/complex pipeline and reward misspecification risks.

sources.title: LoRA
sources.evidence_notes: Low-rank trainable adapters reduce trainable parameters/memory while maintaining quality in original experiments.
sources.limits: Rank/target-module/task choices need eval.

sources.title: QLoRA
sources.evidence_notes: 4-bit frozen base + LoRA greatly reduces fine-tuning memory in original work.
sources.limits: Quantization/training-stack complexity; eval judge limitations noted by authors.

sources.title: LIMA
sources.evidence_notes: Shows strong alignment behavior from only 1k curated examples on a strong pretrained model.
sources.limits: Does not imply small data always wins; capability largely inherited from pretraining.

sources.title: AlpaGasus
sources.evidence_notes: LLM-filtered 9k subset outperformed training on noisy 52k Alpaca set in reported evals.
sources.limits: Strong-model filtering can import judge bias.

sources.title: LESS
sources.evidence_notes: Gradient-similarity selection using 5% of instruction data often outperformed full data for targeted capabilities.
sources.limits: Higher selection complexity; targeted not universal.

sources.title: DoReMi
sources.evidence_notes: Proxy model learns domain mixture weights; reported faster convergence and downstream gains.
sources.limits: Pretraining-scale technique; limited direct Agent OS applicability.

sources.title: Deduplicating Training Data Makes Language Models Better
sources.evidence_notes: Dedup reduced memorization and train-test overlap and achieved equal/better accuracy with fewer steps.
sources.limits: Training-specific, but general dedupe principle transfers to memory/context.

sources.title: The Curse of Recursion / Model Collapse
sources.evidence_notes: Repeated training on generated data can lose distribution tails/model quality.
sources.limits: Does not imply all synthetic data is harmful; provenance/mixing/quality matter.

sources.title: Textbooks Are All You Need
sources.evidence_notes: Curated and synthetic textbook-like data enabled a small coding model to perform strongly in original experiments.
sources.limits: Narrow domain and contamination concerns require care.

sources.title: Distilling Step-by-Step
sources.evidence_notes: Uses teacher rationales as auxiliary supervision for smaller models.
sources.limits: Rationale quality and privacy/provenance matter.

sources.title: Chinchilla Compute-Optimal Training
sources.evidence_notes: Shows compute allocation between parameters and training tokens strongly affects performance.
sources.limits: Specific scaling law estimates evolve with data/model architecture.

sources.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Empirical power-law scaling with model/data/compute established systematic optimization framing.
sources.limits: Superseded/refined in some compute-optimal conclusions by later work.

sources.title: FlashAttention
sources.evidence_notes: IO-aware exact attention reduces memory traffic and accelerates transformer workloads.
sources.limits: Hardware/kernel-specific applicability.

sources.title: vLLM / PagedAttention
sources.evidence_notes: PagedAttention and serving scheduler improve KV-cache utilization and throughput.
sources.limits: Self-hosted serving concern; version/hardware dependent.

sources.title: Speculative Decoding
sources.evidence_notes: Draft-model proposals verified by target can accelerate exact-distribution decoding.
sources.limits: Speedup depends on draft acceptance/hardware/batch regime.

sources.title: Medusa
sources.evidence_notes: Multiple decoding heads propose future tokens and tree verification reduces serial decoding steps.
sources.limits: Requires model augmentation/fine-tuning.

sources.title: GPTQ
sources.evidence_notes: One-shot low-bit weight quantization reduces memory and can speed local inference.
sources.limits: Accuracy/speed depend on model, kernel and hardware.

sources.title: SmoothQuant
sources.evidence_notes: Training-free W8A8 post-training quantization with reported speed/memory benefits.
sources.limits: Primarily data-center GPU inference.

sources.title: OpenAI Rate Limit Guidance
sources.evidence_notes: Honor Retry-After; bounded exponential backoff with jitter; avoid nested retries and retrying non-transient errors.
sources.limits: Provider-specific error semantics.

sources.title: Google Gemini Context Caching
sources.evidence_notes: Large common prompt prefixes increase implicit cache-hit probability; cache tokens are observable.
sources.limits: Provider-specific thresholds and behavior.

sources.title: Microsoft Attention-Sensitive Alerting
sources.evidence_notes: Frames alert value against interruption cost.
sources.limits: Historical work; modern assistant context differs.

sources.title: Need Help? Designing Proactive AI Assistants for Programming
sources.evidence_notes: Modern experimental study of proactive assistant interventions and design tradeoffs.
sources.limits: Programming domain.

sources.title: Magentic-UI
sources.evidence_notes: Co-planning, interruption, sandboxing, allowlists and approval patterns for human-centered web agents.
sources.limits: Experimental system.

sources.title: W3C PROV
sources.evidence_notes: Standard conceptual model of entities, activities, agents and derivation.
sources.limits: May be heavier than Agent OS needs if adopted literally.

sources.title: SLSA Provenance v1.2
sources.evidence_notes: Verifiable build/source provenance model.
sources.limits: Software-artifact scope.

sources.title: Cedar Policy Language
sources.evidence_notes: Deterministic principal/action/resource/context authorization with default-deny-compatible patterns.
sources.limits: Adoption vs simpler custom policy must be benchmarked.

sources.title: Open Policy Agent
sources.evidence_notes: General policy-as-code engine for decoupled authorization decisions.
sources.limits: Operational dependency/complexity.

sources.title: AgentDojo
sources.evidence_notes: Benchmark for prompt injection attacks on tool-using agents.
sources.limits: Attack set evolves with systems.

sources.title: CaMeL: Defeating Prompt Injections by Design
sources.evidence_notes: Separates trusted control flow from untrusted data and uses capability-oriented enforcement.
sources.limits: Research architecture; integration complexity.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026
sources.evidence_notes: Current agent-specific threat taxonomy.
sources.limits: Industry consensus document, not empirical benchmark.

sources.title: NIST AI RMF
sources.evidence_notes: Risk-management framework for AI systems.
sources.limits: Broad governance, not implementation prescription.

sources.title: NIST SSDF
sources.evidence_notes: Secure software-development practices including provenance, secure environments, and root-cause learning.
sources.limits: General software security.

sources.title: Google SRE Error Budget Policy
sources.evidence_notes: Uses reliability budget to decide when feature velocity must yield to reliability work.
sources.limits: Must adapt service SLO concepts to agent quality/safety.

sources.title: Google SRE Eliminating Toil
sources.evidence_notes: Defines repetitive/manual/automatable low-enduring-value work as toil.
sources.limits: Human ops framing.

sources.title: Temporal Durable Execution for AI Agents
sources.evidence_notes: Durable event history/replay and workflow branching address long-running agent failure/replay cost.
sources.limits: Vendor engineering report; adoption should be benchmarked.

sources.title: Microsoft Agent Framework Workflows
sources.evidence_notes: Explicit workflows/checkpoints for ordering and recovery; recommends simpler composition first.
sources.limits: Framework-specific.

sources.title: A2A Protocol
sources.evidence_notes: Cross-framework task/capability exchange without sharing internal memory/tools.
sources.limits: Interoperability still evolving.

sources.title: MCP 2026-07-28 Update
sources.evidence_notes: Stateless/cacheable core direction and extension framework including tasks.
sources.limits: Protocol evolves rapidly.

sources.title: Self-Instruct: Aligning Language Models with Self-Generated Instructions
sources.evidence_notes: Generates, filters, and fine-tunes on synthetic instructions; original work reported substantial novel-task instruction-following gains.
sources.limits: Synthetic errors and self-distribution bias require filtering and real/held-out evaluation.

sources.title: STaR: Self-Taught Reasoner
sources.evidence_notes: Iteratively generates rationales, filters by correct answers, and fine-tunes to bootstrap reasoning.
sources.limits: Requires trustworthy answer oracle; generated rationales may be spurious.

sources.title: Quiet-STaR
sources.evidence_notes: Trains internal rationales across arbitrary text and reports improvements on difficult-token prediction and reasoning benchmarks.
sources.limits: Foundation-model training research; high compute and limited direct Agent OS applicability.

sources.title: Switch Transformers
sources.evidence_notes: Sparse top-1 expert routing increased parameter capacity with lower active compute and reported training speedups.
sources.limits: Model architecture research with communication/training complexity.

sources.title: Sequence-Level Knowledge Distillation
sources.evidence_notes: Sequence-level teacher outputs train smaller/faster student models; foundational distillation reference for generative models.
sources.limits: Original domain was NMT; modern LLM transfer needs task-specific evaluation.

sources.title: Self-Play Fine-Tuning (SPIN)
sources.evidence_notes: Iterative self-play contrasts model-generated outputs with human demonstrations to improve the policy without additional human labels.
sources.limits: Self-generated training loops can amplify bias or narrow distributions without external anchors.

sources.title: Let's Verify Step by Step
sources.evidence_notes: Process supervision outperformed outcome supervision on a MATH subset; released PRM800K with step-level labels and reported active-learning gains.
sources.limits: Math/reasoning setting; human step-label cost and transfer to open-ended agent tasks are unresolved.

sources.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Introduced GRPO and combined targeted math pretraining with RL; self-consistency and training improved mathematical reasoning.
sources.limits: Math-specialized setting; later RL methods may supersede parts of GRPO.

sources.title: Group Sequence Policy Optimization
sources.evidence_notes: Sequence-level policy optimization reported more stable/efficient training than GRPO, especially for MoE RL.
sources.limits: Recent 2025 research and model-family dependence.

sources.title: ORPO: Monolithic Preference Optimization without Reference Model
sources.evidence_notes: Combines favored-style SFT with odds-ratio penalty for disfavored generations without a separate reference model/alignment phase.
sources.limits: Results depend on preference dataset and evaluation methodology.

sources.title: SLiC-HF: Sequence Likelihood Calibration with Human Feedback
sources.evidence_notes: Simpler likelihood-calibration approach using preference data, reported competitive TL;DR results versus PPO-based RLHF.
sources.limits: Task/domain limited and preference-loss landscape continues evolving.

sources.title: RRHF: Rank Responses to Align Language Models with Human Feedback without tears
sources.evidence_notes: Ranks sampled responses and aligns model likelihood ordering; simpler than PPO and highly dependent on candidate sampling quality.
sources.limits: Sampling quality is a major dependency; reward/human evaluation limitations remain.

sources.title: Making Large Language Models Better Reasoners with Step-Aware Verifier
sources.evidence_notes: DIVERSE uses diverse reasoning paths plus step-aware verification and weighted voting; reported gains across reasoning benchmarks.
sources.limits: Older model regime and expensive multi-path inference.

sources.title: Monte Carlo Tree Search Boosts Reasoning via Iterative Preference Learning
sources.evidence_notes: Uses MCTS to derive step-level preference signals and DPO for iterative reasoning improvement.
sources.limits: High search/training cost; arithmetic/commonsense focus.

sources.title: Contrastive Decoding: Open-ended Text Generation as Optimization
sources.evidence_notes: Contrasts expert and amateur model likelihoods under plausibility constraint; reported higher human/automatic open-ended generation quality.
sources.limits: Requires compatible amateur model; newer instruction/reasoning models need re-evaluation.

sources.title: DoLa: Decoding by Contrasting Layers Improves Factuality
sources.evidence_notes: Contrasts later vs earlier layer logits at decoding time and reported truthfulness/factuality gains without retrieval or fine-tuning.
sources.limits: Requires internal logits/layer access and results are model/task dependent.

sources.title: The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration
sources.evidence_notes: Demonstrated degeneration from likelihood-maximizing decoding and introduced nucleus/top-p sampling for open-ended text.
sources.limits: Predates instruction-tuned frontier models; task-dependent decoding behavior.

sources.title: Locally Typical Sampling
sources.evidence_notes: Information-theoretic typicality filter reported competitive quality and reduced repetition versus top-k/nucleus on studied tasks.
sources.limits: Open-ended generation focus; not necessarily appropriate for deterministic agent outputs.

sources.title: Contrastive Search Is What You Need For Neural Text Generation
sources.evidence_notes: Evaluated contrastive search across languages/tasks and reported strong open-ended generation without extra training for many models.
sources.limits: Open-ended generation focus; representation assumptions vary by model.

sources.title: Representation Engineering: A Top-Down Approach to AI Transparency
sources.evidence_notes: Frames population-level representation monitoring/manipulation for high-level behaviors and safety-relevant concepts.
sources.limits: Interpretability/steering evidence does not establish robust production control.

sources.title: Steering Llama 2 via Contrastive Activation Addition
sources.evidence_notes: CAA derives behavior steering vectors from contrastive activations and reported strong behavioral shifts with limited capability loss on studied Llama 2 settings.
sources.limits: Requires weight/activation access; steering may have unintended off-target effects.

sources.title: Locating and Editing Factual Associations in GPT (ROME)
sources.evidence_notes: Causal tracing identified factual association computations and ROME directly edited selected facts while testing specificity/generalization.
sources.limits: Editing many facts can degrade models; architecture-specific assumptions.

sources.title: Mass Editing Memory in a Transformer (MEMIT)
sources.evidence_notes: Extends direct model editing to many factual associations.
sources.limits: Sequential/mass editing can cause forgetting and editing degradation; precomputation cost exists.

sources.title: Model Editing at Scale leads to Gradual and Catastrophic Forgetting
sources.evidence_notes: Large numbers of sequential ROME/MEMIT edits caused reduced editability, forgotten prior edits, and downstream performance degradation.
sources.limits: Specific methods/models; newer editors may differ.

sources.title: Extending Context Window via Position Interpolation
sources.evidence_notes: Position interpolation extends RoPE context by rescaling positions into trained range with limited fine-tuning and reported long-context gains.
sources.limits: Model architecture/fine-tuning specific; nominal context length does not guarantee useful retrieval/reasoning.

sources.title: YaRN: Efficient Context Window Extension of Large Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: RoPE scaling/fine-tuning method for efficient context extension with reduced training tokens/steps in original results.
sources.limits: Self-hosted model modification; useful context still requires behavioral evaluation.

sources.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
sources.evidence_notes: Selective state-space architecture reported linear sequence scaling and strong throughput/performance at studied scales.
sources.limits: Architecture research; Transformer ecosystem and later hybrids may dominate specific tasks.

sources.title: Improving language models by retrieving from trillions of tokens (RETRO)
sources.evidence_notes: Retrieval-enhanced transformer used massive external datastore and matched much larger dense models on studied language-modeling settings.
sources.limits: Model-training architecture; large retrieval infrastructure.

sources.title: Generalization through Memorization: Nearest Neighbor Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Interpolating LM predictions with nearest-neighbor datastore improved perplexity and enabled domain adaptation without retraining.
sources.limits: Older LM setting; datastore latency/memory.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
sources.evidence_notes: Foundational neural retriever + generator architecture for knowledge-intensive tasks.
sources.limits: Early RAG architecture; modern application RAG differs substantially.

sources.title: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization
sources.evidence_notes: Activation-aware low-bit weight quantization protects salient channels and reported strong quality plus >3x TinyChat speedups on studied hardware.
sources.limits: Hardware/kernel/model dependent.

sources.title: SpecInfer
sources.evidence_notes: Tree-based speculative inference and parallel verification reported 1.5–3.5x serving speedups while preserving target-model distribution/performance.
sources.limits: Serving-stack complexity and acceptance depend on model/hardware.

sources.title: Weak-to-Strong Generalization
sources.evidence_notes: Studied strong models trained from weak-model supervision; strong models exceeded weak supervisors but did not recover full capability; auxiliary losses helped.
sources.limits: Analogy to superhuman oversight is imperfect and results are early.

sources.title: Scalable AI Safety via Doubly-Efficient Debate
sources.evidence_notes: Theoretical debate protocols aimed at verifying harder computations with weaker verifiers and efficient honest strategies.
sources.limits: Primarily theoretical; production LLM debate can amplify biases.

sources.title: Efficient Knowledge Editing via Minimal Precomputation
sources.evidence_notes: Shows MEMIT/related editing precomputation can be reduced substantially from original large hidden-vector precomputation.
sources.limits: Still inherits core knowledge-editing reliability concerns.

sources.title: OpenAI PRM800K
sources.evidence_notes: 800k human step-level correctness labels accompanying Let's Verify Step by Step; repository archived May 29, 2026 but remains a useful historical dataset.
sources.limits: Math-only labels and archived project.

sources.title: OpenAI Function Calling
sources.evidence_notes: Current API guidance for schema-based tools; recommends tool search/deferred loading for large catalogs.
sources.limits: Provider/model-specific behavior evolves.

sources.title: OpenAI Tool Search
sources.evidence_notes: Deferred tool loading can reduce upfront schema tokens and preserve cache; namespaces/MCP recommended, with fewer than ~10 functions per namespace as a best-practice target.
sources.limits: Only supported by selected newer models; discovery adds a step.

sources.title: OpenAI Compaction
sources.evidence_notes: Server-side or explicit compaction reduces long-running context while carrying forward needed state; supports threshold-based compaction.
sources.limits: Opaque provider compaction must be treated as provider-specific derived state, not canonical memory.

sources.title: OpenAI Background Mode
sources.evidence_notes: Asynchronous long-running responses can be polled and streaming can resume from sequence cursors.
sources.limits: Provider-specific retention and latency behavior.

sources.title: OpenAI Model Selection
sources.evidence_notes: Current guidance explicitly treats model and reasoning effort as cost/latency/quality choices by task.
sources.limits: Provider claims are priors; Agent OS needs local workload evals.

sources.title: OpenAI Reasoning Models
sources.evidence_notes: Current models expose model-dependent reasoning effort/mode controls; higher effort trades latency/tokens for more reasoning.
sources.limits: Values/defaults/model support change over time.

sources.title: OpenAI Deployment Checklist
sources.evidence_notes: Current production checklist includes deferred tool search and preservation of progress/final-response phase metadata in supported models.
sources.limits: Provider-specific.

sources.title: OpenAI Using Tools
sources.evidence_notes: Current overview for built-in tools, functions, tool search, MCP and programmatic tool calling.
sources.limits: Provider-specific.

sources.title: OpenAI Model Guidance
sources.evidence_notes: Current model-family guidance and migration considerations; emphasizes task requirements, cost and latency rather than one universal model.
sources.limits: Vendor guidance and rapid product churn.

sources.title: Measuring and Narrowing the Compositionality Gap in Language Models (Self-Ask)
sources.evidence_notes: Self-Ask explicitly decomposes multi-hop questions into follow-up questions and can route them to search; reported narrower compositionality gaps.
sources.limits: Older GPT-3-era evidence; current tool-using models may internalize parts of the behavior.

sources.title: Take a Step Back: Evoking Reasoning via Abstraction
sources.evidence_notes: Step-Back Prompting derives higher-level concepts/principles before solving specific problems; reported gains on STEM, QA and multi-hop reasoning.
sources.limits: Prompt-era/model dependent and may add redundant reasoning on current reasoning models.

sources.title: Generated Knowledge Prompting for Commonsense Reasoning
sources.evidence_notes: Generate candidate knowledge first, then condition answer on it; reported gains on commonsense benchmarks.
sources.limits: Self-generated knowledge can hallucinate; authoritative retrieval is preferable for current facts.

sources.title: Large Language Models as Analogical Reasoners
sources.evidence_notes: Model self-generates relevant examples/knowledge before solving; reported gains over zero-shot/manual few-shot CoT on reasoning and coding tasks.
sources.limits: Generated analogies can be wrong and add inference cost.

sources.title: Chain-of-Verification Reduces Hallucination in Large Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Draft, generate verification questions, answer them independently, then revise; reported lower hallucination across studied tasks.
sources.limits: Closed-book self-verification still lacks authoritative external truth and can share model blind spots.

sources.title: Self-Discover: Large Language Models Self-Compose Reasoning Structures
sources.evidence_notes: Selects and composes atomic reasoning modules into task-specific reasoning structure; reported strong benchmark gains at lower inference compute than self-consistency.
sources.limits: Results on 2024-era models; structure-generation overhead and transfer need local eval.

sources.title: Re-Reading Improves Reasoning in Large Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Re2 repeats/re-reads the question in the input and reported broad reasoning gains across 14 datasets in original experiments.
sources.limits: Very simple intervention with likely strong model-version sensitivity; adds duplicated input tokens.

sources.title: Large Language Models Understand and Can be Enhanced by Emotional Stimuli
sources.evidence_notes: EmotionPrompt added emotional/stakes stimuli and reported gains on several 2023 models/tasks plus a human study.
sources.limits: Mechanism is unclear, susceptible to benchmark/model-era effects, and inappropriate as a production reliability assumption.

sources.title: Thread of Thought Unraveling Chaotic Contexts
sources.evidence_notes: Segments and analyzes chaotic context while selecting relevant information; reported gains on QA and multi-turn response tasks.
sources.limits: May duplicate modern retrieval/context-selection behavior and increase output tokens.

sources.title: Chain-of-Table: Evolving Tables in the Reasoning Chain
sources.evidence_notes: Uses iterative table operations as structured intermediate state; reported strong table QA/fact verification results.
sources.limits: Table-specific and current models/tools may perform better with deterministic dataframe/SQL operations.

sources.title: Learning to Reason and Memorize with Self-Notes
sources.evidence_notes: Allows interleaved self-notes while reading context and reported improvements over CoT/scratchpad on studied tasks.
sources.limits: Requires compatible training/prompting; freeform notes can expand context and preserve errors.

sources.title: Chain-of-Knowledge: Grounding LLMs via Dynamic Knowledge Adapting
sources.evidence_notes: Prepares rationales, detects disagreement, queries heterogeneous structured/unstructured sources, progressively corrects and consolidates answers.
sources.limits: Complex multi-stage pipeline; retrieval and rationale quality can interact badly.

sources.title: Boosting Language Models Reasoning with Chain-of-Knowledge Prompting
sources.evidence_notes: Generates explicit knowledge triples as reasoning evidence and adds factuality/faithfulness verification.
sources.limits: Structured triple representation may not suit all reasoning tasks.

sources.title: Guiding Large Language Models via Directional Stimulus Prompting
sources.evidence_notes: Small tunable model generates instance-specific hints/stimuli for a black-box LLM; reported task gains with supervised/RL optimization.
sources.limits: Adds a second learned policy and task-specific training complexity.

sources.title: Chain-of-Symbol Prompting Elicits Planning in Large Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Represents planning state with compact symbols rather than verbose natural-language CoT and reported large gains/token reductions on benchmark planning tasks.
sources.limits: Synthetic planning benchmarks and handcrafted symbolic representation.

sources.title: Recitation-Augmented Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Samples one or more internally recalled passages before answering and reported closed-book QA gains.
sources.limits: Recitation can confidently reproduce stale/hallucinated memory; retrieval is safer for authoritative facts.

sources.title: Meta-Prompting: Enhancing Language Models with Task-Agnostic Scaffolding
sources.evidence_notes: One model orchestrates specialized expert instances/subqueries and aggregates results; reported gains on reasoning/puzzle tasks with tools.
sources.limits: High call/coordination cost and overlaps with normal orchestrator-worker systems.

sources.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Automatic curriculum, executable skill library, environment feedback and self-verification produced cumulative in-context lifelong learning in Minecraft without fine-tuning.
sources.limits: Embodied sandbox domain; performance claims do not establish general personal-assistant transfer.

sources.title: Eureka: Human-Level Reward Design via Coding Large Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: LLM evolves executable reward code and uses simulator/RL feedback; reported outperforming human-engineered rewards on 83% of 29 environments.
sources.limits: Requires cheaply executable objective feedback; simulator/reward misspecification remains central risk.

sources.title: Mathematical discoveries from program search with large language models (FunSearch)
sources.evidence_notes: Frozen LLM plus systematic evaluator, best-shot prompting, skeletonized code search and island diversity discovered new mathematical constructions and algorithms.
sources.limits: Works best where candidate programs are cheaply and objectively evaluable; used very large sampling budgets.

sources.title: AlphaEvolve: A Gemini-powered coding agent for designing advanced algorithms
sources.evidence_notes: Uses fast/strong model ensemble, automated evaluators and evolutionary program database; reported deployed improvements to data-center scheduling, AI training kernels, hardware and math.
sources.limits: Primary builder report rather than peer-reviewed end-to-end system paper; domains have executable evaluators.

sources.title: AlphaEvolve: How our Gemini-powered coding agent is scaling impact across fields
sources.evidence_notes: 2026 follow-up reports AlphaEvolve as a regular infrastructure optimization tool and additional production/scientific impacts.
sources.limits: Vendor report; detailed independent reproduction is limited.

sources.title: Gödel Agent: A Self-Referential Agent Framework for Recursive Self-Improvement
sources.evidence_notes: Agent modifies its own logic/behavior under high-level objectives and reports iterative performance gains on math/agent tasks.
sources.limits: Benchmark success does not establish safe unconstrained self-modification; high governance risk.

sources.title: Automated Design of Agentic Systems
sources.evidence_notes: Meta Agent Search programs new agent systems in code, maintains an archive of discoveries, and reports transfer across domains/models.
sources.limits: Generated agent code is an untrusted artifact; search can overfit benchmark/evaluator.

sources.title: Darwin Gödel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
sources.evidence_notes: Maintains an archive/tree of self-modified coding agents and empirically validates variants, reporting SWE-bench 20→50 and Polyglot 14.2→30.7 with sandboxing/human oversight.
sources.limits: Benchmark improvements do not prove real-life utility or safety; self-modification search is costly and evaluator-bound.

sources.title: Polaris: A Gödel Agent Framework for Small Language Models through Experience-Abstracted Policy Repair
sources.evidence_notes: 2026 framework distills failures into compact reusable strategies and applies conservative persistent policy/code patches for smaller models.
sources.limits: Recent preprint; benchmark setting and self-reported policy repair need broader replication.

sources.title: AgentSquare: Automatic LLM Agent Search in Modular Design Space
sources.evidence_notes: Searches Planning/Reasoning/Tool/Memory modules via evolution/recombination and uses an in-context performance predictor to skip poor designs; reported 17.2% average gain over best known human designs on six benchmarks.
sources.limits: Benchmark-defined module space can bias discoveries; predictor can discard unconventional good designs.

sources.title: An Architecture Search Framework for Inference-Time Techniques (Archon)
sources.evidence_notes: Automates selection/composition of inference-time techniques and models under compute budget; reported 15.1 percentage-point average improvement over frontier baselines on studied benchmarks.
sources.limits: Search may overfit target benchmarks and can be inference-expensive.

sources.title: Language Agent Tree Search
sources.evidence_notes: Combines reasoning, acting, planning, LM value functions, reflection and environmental feedback through Monte Carlo tree search.
sources.limits: High test-time compute and value-model quality sensitivity.

sources.title: Agent-Pro: Learning to Evolve via Policy-Level Reflection and Optimization
sources.evidence_notes: Reflects over trajectories/beliefs and uses depth-first search to refine persistent behavioral policy in interactive games.
sources.limits: Game domains; policy beliefs can overfit or encode incorrect causal stories.

sources.title: AgentPro: Enhancing LLM Agents with Automated Process Supervision
sources.evidence_notes: Uses MCTS-generated step annotations, process reward model and rejection sampling to avoid erroneous reasoning paths; reported gains on four datasets.
sources.limits: Process supervision inherits reward-model biases and adds substantial training/inference complexity.

sources.title: Mixture-of-Agents Enhances Large Language Model Capabilities
sources.evidence_notes: Layered architecture feeds outputs from multiple agents into subsequent agents and reported gains on several language-model benchmarks.
sources.limits: Large inference multiplier, correlated errors, and benchmark-specific aggregator behavior.

sources.title: Teaching Language Models To Gather Information Proactively
sources.evidence_notes: Trains proactive information gathering by rewarding questions that reveal genuinely new hidden user context; reported automatic/human-evaluation gains.
sources.limits: Clarification-heavy benchmark; proactive questioning can impose user effort and should be utility-gated.

sources.title: Tunable LLM-based Proactive Recommendation Agent
sources.evidence_notes: Studies tunable proactive recommendation agents and the tradeoff between proactive behavior and user preference.
sources.limits: Recommendation setting; transfer to general personal assistant needs local HCI evaluation.

sources.title: Detecting hallucinations in large language models using semantic entropy
sources.evidence_notes: Clusters sampled generations by meaning and measures entropy over semantic classes; predicts confabulations and improves selective QA via abstention.
sources.limits: Detects an important subset of hallucinations, not all factual/logical failure; multi-sample cost and entailment clustering required.

sources.title: Language Models (Mostly) Know What They Know
sources.evidence_notes: Studies P(True)/P(IK) self-evaluation and reports useful calibration/scaling under studied formats.
sources.limits: Calibration is prompt/task/model dependent and P(IK) generalization degrades on new tasks.

sources.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
sources.evidence_notes: Found modern neural classifiers overconfident and showed post-hoc temperature scaling as a strong simple calibration baseline.
sources.limits: Classification-era result; free-form LLM uncertainty needs additional methods.

sources.title: Simple and Scalable Predictive Uncertainty Estimation using Deep Ensembles
sources.evidence_notes: Independent ensembles provide strong predictive uncertainty and OOD signals in supervised settings.
sources.limits: Multiple full models are costly; LLM-agent errors can be strongly correlated.

sources.title: The engineering challenges of scaling interpretability
sources.evidence_notes: Anthropic reports scaling sparse-autoencoder feature dictionaries to much larger models and highlights engineering/infrastructure constraints.
sources.limits: Features/probes are partial representations and not guaranteed causal or complete.

sources.title: Open-sourcing circuit-tracing tools
sources.evidence_notes: Open-sources attribution-graph/circuit-tracing method for selected open-weight models to inspect internal computation pathways.
sources.limits: Partial reconstruction; interpretability does not by itself guarantee control or correctness.

sources.title: SparseGPT: Massive Language Models Can Be Accurately Pruned in One-Shot
sources.evidence_notes: One-shot second-order-inspired pruning reached high sparsity on large models with minimal perplexity loss in reported settings.
sources.limits: Actual speedup requires sparse kernel/hardware support; downstream task quality must be checked.

sources.title: A Simple and Effective Pruning Approach for Large Language Models (Wanda)
sources.evidence_notes: Activation-aware weight pruning without retraining performed competitively on LLaMA-family models.
sources.limits: Sparsity does not automatically translate into wall-clock speedup.

sources.title: Movement Pruning: Adaptive Sparsity by Fine-Tuning
sources.evidence_notes: First-order movement-based pruning adapts sparsity during fine-tuning and reported good high-sparsity transfer performance.
sources.limits: Older BERT-era transfer setting; requires training.

sources.title: The Lottery Ticket Hypothesis
sources.evidence_notes: Shows dense networks can contain sparse subnetworks that train effectively in studied vision architectures.
sources.limits: Foundational sparsity concept; direct large-language-model application is not guaranteed.

sources.title: Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning for NLP (Adapters)
sources.evidence_notes: Task-specific adapter modules approach full fine-tuning quality while adding a small parameter fraction.
sources.limits: Older encoder setting; adapter placement/serving overhead varies in modern LLMs.

sources.title: Prefix-Tuning: Optimizing Continuous Prompts for Generation
sources.evidence_notes: Learns small continuous prefixes while freezing model weights; reported competitive low-data generation performance.
sources.limits: Requires model/training access and prefix support; not comparable to ordinary text prompt editing.

sources.title: The Power of Scale for Parameter-Efficient Prompt Tuning
sources.evidence_notes: Learns soft prompts for frozen models and found competitiveness improves with model scale.
sources.limits: Model-family/training-specific; hosted APIs rarely expose this.

sources.title: Few-Shot Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning is Better and Cheaper than In-Context Learning (IA3/T-Few)
sources.evidence_notes: Introduces IA3 activation scaling and reports strong few-shot PEFT with lower repeated inference cost than ICL.
sources.limits: Training access required; tasks/data distribution matter.

sources.title: BitFit: Simple Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning
sources.evidence_notes: Fine-tunes only bias terms and reports competitive performance for small/medium data on BERT-family tasks.
sources.limits: Older encoder models; may underfit modern generative tasks.

sources.title: Model soups
sources.evidence_notes: Averaging compatible fine-tuned model weights improved accuracy/robustness without inference-time ensemble cost in studied settings.
sources.limits: Only works when weight solutions are compatible/in same basin; careless merging can destroy capability.

sources.title: TIES-Merging: Resolving Interference When Merging Models
sources.evidence_notes: Trims small changes, resolves sign conflicts and merges aligned parameter updates to reduce task interference.
sources.limits: Merged-model behavior still needs comprehensive downstream/safety evaluation.

sources.title: Training Deep Nets with Sublinear Memory Cost
sources.evidence_notes: Activation/gradient checkpointing trades recomputation for much lower training memory.
sources.limits: Extra compute and communication; modern frameworks implement variants with different tradeoffs.

sources.title: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models
sources.evidence_notes: Partitions optimizer state, gradients and parameters across data-parallel workers to reduce per-device memory while preserving scaling.
sources.limits: Distributed training engineering complexity and communication constraints.

sources.title: PyTorch Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP2)
sources.evidence_notes: Current PyTorch fully_shard uses per-parameter DTensor sharding and all-gather/free hooks to reduce replicated model state.
sources.limits: Training infrastructure concern, not application-layer Agent OS.

sources.title: Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism
sources.evidence_notes: Intra-layer tensor/model parallelism enabled multi-billion-parameter training with good scaling in original experiments.
sources.limits: Communication/hardware topology sensitive; newer Megatron implementations extend it substantially.

sources.title: DeepSpeed Ulysses
sources.evidence_notes: Partitions sequence dimension with all-to-all attention communication for efficient very-long-sequence training.
sources.limits: Large distributed training only.

sources.title: FlashAttention-2
sources.evidence_notes: Improves FlashAttention work partitioning and reports near-GEMM efficiency plus end-to-end training speedups.
sources.limits: GPU/kernel-specific and continually superseded by newer implementations.

sources.title: Mirostat: A Neural Text Decoding Algorithm that Directly Controls Perplexity
sources.evidence_notes: Feedback-based decoder adapts sampling to target perplexity and avoid repetition/incoherence traps in open-ended generation.
sources.limits: Older open-ended generation setting; not appropriate for tool/structured outputs.

sources.title: Efficient Guided Generation for Large Language Models (Outlines)
sources.evidence_notes: Finite-state-machine indexing enables regex/CFG-constrained generation with low overhead and structural guarantees.
sources.limits: Structural correctness does not guarantee semantic correctness.

sources.title: XGrammar: Flexible and Efficient Structured Generation Engine for Large Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Optimized CFG execution and co-designed inference integration reported near-zero-overhead structured generation in studied systems.
sources.limits: Self-hosted inference concern; grammar complexity and semantic validation remain.

sources.title: XGrammar 2
sources.evidence_notes: 2026 engine adds dynamic dispatch, JIT compilation, cross-grammar caching and richer parsing for agentic structured outputs.
sources.limits: Recent system paper; integration-specific performance.

sources.title: Sentence-BERT
sources.evidence_notes: Siamese/triplet sentence representations made semantic similarity search practical compared with pairwise cross-encoding.
sources.limits: Modern embedding models substantially supersede BERT-era quality; concept remains foundational.

sources.title: Matryoshka Representation Learning
sources.evidence_notes: Trains embeddings whose prefixes retain useful coarse-to-fine information, enabling adaptive dimension/storage/retrieval tradeoffs.
sources.limits: Embedding model must be trained for Matryoshka structure; arbitrary truncation is unsafe.

sources.title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
sources.evidence_notes: Foundational teacher/student distillation and specialist-model concepts for compressing ensemble knowledge.
sources.limits: Modern generative distillation has additional sequence/alignment concerns.

sources.title: Specifying and Verifying Systems With TLA+
sources.evidence_notes: Formal state-machine specifications and model checking expose concurrency/protocol design errors before implementation.
sources.limits: Specification is an additional artifact that can itself be wrong; best for critical state machines/protocols, not every function.

sources.title: QuickCheck: A Lightweight Tool for Random Testing of Haskell Programs
sources.evidence_notes: Properties plus generated random inputs find edge cases beyond hand-authored examples; shrinking patterns inspired modern property-based testing.
sources.limits: Quality depends on useful invariants and generators; random testing is not proof.

sources.title: Z3: An Efficient SMT Solver
sources.evidence_notes: SMT solving supports exact reasoning over arithmetic, bitvectors, arrays and uninterpreted functions and is widely used in program verification.
sources.limits: Requires formalizable constraints; solver complexity can explode.

sources.title: Practical Bayesian Optimization of Machine Learning Algorithms
sources.evidence_notes: Models expensive black-box objective and selects new trials by acquisition function, including variable experiment cost and parallelism.
sources.limits: Surrogate assumptions and dimensionality matter; less useful for cheap/discrete irregular search spaces.

sources.title: Hyperband: A Novel Bandit-Based Approach to Hyperparameter Optimization
sources.evidence_notes: Allocates progressively more resource to promising random configurations and aggressively stops poor ones; reported large speedups over competitors.
sources.limits: Requires a meaningful partial-resource performance signal.

sources.title: Population Based Training of Neural Networks
sources.evidence_notes: Asynchronously exploits strong runs and explores hyperparameter mutations during training, discovering schedules rather than fixed values.
sources.limits: Training-specific and compute-intensive; can collapse diversity.

sources.title: Optuna: A Next-generation Hyperparameter Optimization Framework
sources.evidence_notes: Define-by-run search spaces and pluggable sampling/pruning provide practical distributed hyperparameter optimization.
sources.limits: Framework is implementation tooling; optimization validity depends on objective/splits.

sources.title: Overcoming catastrophic forgetting in neural networks
sources.evidence_notes: Elastic Weight Consolidation penalizes changes to parameters estimated important for previous tasks to reduce forgetting.
sources.limits: Importance approximation/task boundaries can fail; large task sequences still accumulate constraints.

sources.title: Gradient Episodic Memory for Continual Learning
sources.evidence_notes: Stores episodic exemplars and constrains updates so new learning does not increase loss on prior memories, while measuring backward/forward transfer.
sources.limits: Memory scales with exemplars; original benchmarks are small vision tasks.

sources.title: Learning without Forgetting
sources.evidence_notes: Uses predictions on new-task data as distillation targets to preserve old capabilities when old data is unavailable.
sources.limits: Old-task data distribution is not directly replayed; vision-era evidence.

sources.title: Deep Learning with Differential Privacy
sources.evidence_notes: DP-SGD clips per-example gradients and adds calibrated noise with privacy accounting to bound training-data leakage.
sources.limits: Privacy-utility-compute tradeoff can be severe; privacy parameters require careful interpretation.

sources.title: The Algorithmic Foundations of Differential Privacy
sources.evidence_notes: Foundational framework for formally bounded privacy loss under arbitrary auxiliary information and composed analyses.
sources.limits: Aggregate statistical privacy does not solve authorization, raw-data access or all memorization risks by itself.

sources.title: Communication-Efficient Learning of Deep Networks from Decentralized Data
sources.evidence_notes: FedAvg trains shared models from local client updates without centralizing raw data and reduces communication rounds relative to synchronized SGD.
sources.limits: Model updates can still leak information; non-IID clients and trust/aggregation remain issues.

sources.title: Practical Secure Aggregation for Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning
sources.evidence_notes: Cryptographic protocol lets server recover aggregate updates without learning individual user contributions, robust to client dropout.
sources.limits: Protects aggregation contents, not malicious model behavior or all metadata.

sources.title: A Comprehensive Study of Convergent and Commutative Replicated Data Types
sources.evidence_notes: CRDT mathematical conditions support convergence of replicated state without synchronous coordination, useful for disconnected/multi-device systems.
sources.limits: Business invariants may require stronger consistency than convergence alone.

sources.title: A Contextual-Bandit Approach to Personalized News Article Recommendation
sources.evidence_notes: Contextual bandit learns action policy from contextual feedback while balancing exploration/exploitation and introduced offline replay evaluation on logged randomized traffic.
sources.limits: Naive online exploration can annoy or harm users; logged-policy evaluation requires propensities/coverage.

sources.title: Generalization in Adaptive Data Analysis and Holdout Reuse
sources.evidence_notes: Shows repeatedly adapting hypotheses to the same holdout can overfit it and develops mechanisms for reusable validation under adaptive analysis.
sources.limits: Formal guarantees rely on specific statistical assumptions/mechanisms; practical private holdouts remain important.

sources.title: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems
sources.evidence_notes: Identifies entanglement, hidden feedback loops, undeclared consumers, data dependencies, configuration debt and changing external world as systemic ML risks.
sources.limits: Qualitative engineering analysis, but highly relevant to long-lived adaptive systems.

sources.title: Rules of Machine Learning: Best Practices for ML Engineering
sources.evidence_notes: Advocates simple baselines, trustworthy pipelines, measurable product goals, training-serving consistency and adding complexity only after simple gains are exhausted.
sources.limits: Heuristic engineering guidance, not a controlled experiment.

sources.title: Machine Learning: The High Interest Credit Card of Technical Debt
sources.evidence_notes: Earlier production-systems warning that ML's quick wins create hidden system maintenance burdens and feedback dependencies.
sources.limits: Broad qualitative patterns; architecture specifics have evolved.

sources.title: Should We Respect LLMs? Prompt Politeness Study
sources.evidence_notes: Cross-lingual study found rude prompts often hurt performance, but maximal politeness was not universally optimal and effects differed by language.
sources.limits: Specific tasks/models/languages; politeness is not a reliable optimization primitive.

sources.title: LLM Politeness Study on frontier models
sources.evidence_notes: More recent empirical project across GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Gemini-3 Flash Preview reports minimal/no statistically significant accuracy effect from politeness on sampled MMLU-Pro questions.
sources.limits: Community study, modest benchmark sample and only one task family.

sources.title: Efficient and robust approximate nearest neighbor search using HNSW
sources.evidence_notes: Hierarchical navigable small-world graph index provides high-recall approximate nearest-neighbor search with tunable construction/search effort.
sources.limits: Worst-case behavior can be poor; optimal parameters depend strongly on data distribution.

sources.title: Worst-case Performance of Popular Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search Implementations
sources.evidence_notes: Shows popular graph ANN methods including HNSW can have linear-time behavior on constructed hard instances, reinforcing need for local recall/latency benchmarking.
sources.limits: Worst-case constructions do not imply typical practical failure.

sources.title: Detecting near-duplicates for web crawling
sources.evidence_notes: Large-scale near-duplicate detection using fingerprinting/SimHash-style technique for web crawling.
sources.limits: Near-duplicate page detection differs from semantically complementary documents.

sources.title: On the Resemblance and Containment of Documents
sources.evidence_notes: Defines document resemblance/containment using shingles and random-sampling fingerprints, foundational for MinHash/LSH duplicate detection.
sources.limits: Lexical resemblance is not semantic identity.

sources.title: Splink Fellegi-Sunter model guide
sources.evidence_notes: Explains probabilistic record linkage using prior match probability and m/u evidence weights; supports interpretable match probabilities and field-level evidence.
sources.limits: Conditional-independence assumptions can be violated by correlated fields.

sources.title: Dedupe blocking and smart comparisons
sources.evidence_notes: Blocking/index predicates drastically reduce pair comparisons while trying to preserve coverage of true duplicate pairs; learned blocking can select a compact rule set.
sources.limits: Poor blocking causes unrecoverable false negatives.

sources.title: Comprehensive insights into bitemporal databases
sources.evidence_notes: 2026 review distinguishes valid time (when fact is true in modeled reality) from transaction time (when stored/known by system), useful for evolving personal/organizational knowledge.
sources.limits: Database literature is broader than lightweight file/SQLite implementations.

sources.title: Semantics of time-varying information
sources.evidence_notes: Formal treatment of valid time and transaction time semantics for changing facts.
sources.limits: Older relational-database framing; core temporal semantics remain useful.

sources.title: Faithful Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
sources.evidence_notes: Translates natural language into a symbolic reasoning program and executes it deterministically; reported gains across math, planning, multi-hop QA and relational inference.
sources.limits: Solver correctness is only with respect to the parsed specification; semantic translation can still be wrong.

sources.title: Logic-LM: Empowering Large Language Models with Symbolic Solvers
sources.evidence_notes: LLM formalizes logic problem, solver derives answer, and solver errors guide re-formalization; reported substantial gains over direct/CoT baselines.
sources.limits: Formalization errors remain central; self-refinement should be solver-grounded.

sources.title: SatLM: Satisfiability-Aided Language Models Using Declarative Prompting
sources.evidence_notes: LLM emits declarative constraints while an automated theorem/SAT solver performs search; outperformed program-aided imperative approaches on studied tasks.
sources.limits: Guarantee applies to generated specification, not original intent.

sources.title: Large Language Models for Supply Chain Optimization / OptiGuide
sources.evidence_notes: LLM interfaces with an existing optimization model for natural-language what-if analysis while keeping proprietary model data out of the LLM context.
sources.limits: Requires a validated optimization model and safe code/solver interface.

sources.title: LLMOPT: Learning to Define and Solve General Optimization Problems from Scratch
sources.evidence_notes: Five-element formulation, multi-instruction tuning and solver-code generation improved optimization generalization across varied problem types.
sources.limits: Specialized training and exact solver verification remain necessary.

sources.title: ORLM: Training Large Models for Automated Optimization Modeling
sources.evidence_notes: OR-Instruct synthetic data and 7B specialist models improved natural-language optimization modeling and solver code on multiple benchmarks.
sources.limits: Domain-specialist approach; benchmark and generated-code validation matter.

sources.title: NL4Opt Competition
sources.evidence_notes: Benchmarks extraction of optimization entities and generation of a logical representation convertible to solver form.
sources.limits: Primarily LP modeling rather than all optimization classes.

sources.title: Preble: Efficient Distributed Prompt Scheduling for LLM Serving
sources.evidence_notes: Routes requests across distributed replicas to exploit shared prompt-prefix KV cache while balancing load; reported substantial average/tail-latency gains.
sources.limits: Requires self-hosted distributed inference and workload prefix locality.

sources.title: Gorilla: Large Language Model Connected with Massive APIs
sources.evidence_notes: Fine-tuned API calling plus retriever over API docs reduced hallucinated calls and adapted to changing documentation in original APIBench evaluation.
sources.limits: Older benchmark/model generation; current tool schemas may make training unnecessary for many cases.

sources.title: LLM+P: Empowering Large Language Models with Optimal Planning Proficiency
sources.evidence_notes: LLM translates language into PDDL, deterministic planner finds feasible/optimal plan, LLM translates back; dramatically stronger than direct LLM planning on studied domains.
sources.limits: Translation to PDDL can misrepresent intent/state/action semantics.

sources.title: ConU: Conformal Uncertainty in Large Language Models with Correctness Coverage Guarantees
sources.evidence_notes: Applies conformal prediction to black-box LLM free-form generation and reports calibrated prediction sets with target correctness coverage across multiple models/datasets.
sources.limits: Guarantees rely on exchangeability/calibration assumptions and the chosen nonconformity/correctness definition; not universal semantic truth guarantees.

sources.title: SelectiveNet: A Deep Neural Network with an Integrated Reject Option
sources.evidence_notes: Jointly trains prediction and reject/coverage behavior to improve risk-coverage tradeoff.
sources.limits: Classical supervised setting; LLM application needs adapted uncertainty features and calibration.

sources.title: DeepXplore: Automated Whitebox Testing of Deep Learning Systems
sources.evidence_notes: Uses neuron coverage plus differential behavior across models to discover corner-case failures without manual labels.
sources.limits: Neuron coverage is an imperfect adequacy proxy and modern LLM behavior differs from image/classification DNNs.

sources.title: DeepTest: Automated Testing of Deep-Neural-Network-driven Autonomous Cars
sources.evidence_notes: Applies realistic semantics-preserving transformations such as weather/lighting changes to uncover model failures without a full test oracle.
sources.limits: Autonomous-driving domain; metamorphic relation validity is domain-specific.

sources.title: Bidirectional Empowerment of Metamorphic Testing and Large Language Models: A Systematic Survey
sources.evidence_notes: 2026 survey of 93 primary studies covering metamorphic testing for hallucination, fairness, robustness, RAG, dialogue, code and agents, plus LLM-assisted metamorphic-test generation.
sources.limits: Survey synthesizes heterogeneous methods; relation quality remains the key oracle.

sources.title: Validating LLM-Generated Programs with Metamorphic Prompt Testing
sources.evidence_notes: Paraphrases programming prompts and cross-validates generated implementations; reported detection of 75% of erroneous GPT-4 programs at 8.6% false positive on HumanEval.
sources.limits: HumanEval and paraphrase relations do not cover all program semantics.

sources.title: DiffSpec: Differential Testing with LLMs using Natural Language Specifications and Code Artifacts
sources.evidence_notes: LLM-guided test generation compares multiple conforming implementations and found confirmed eBPF/Wasm bugs.
sources.limits: Needs multiple independent implementations/spec artifacts and careful adjudication of intended differences.

sources.title: Atheris: Coverage-Guided Python Fuzzing
sources.evidence_notes: Coverage-guided mutation fuzzer for Python/native extensions, with instrumentation, structure-aware custom mutators and regression-corpus workflows.
sources.limits: Coverage-guided byte mutation is inefficient for highly structured inputs without structure-aware mutators.

sources.title: LLVM libFuzzer
sources.evidence_notes: In-process coverage-guided evolutionary fuzzing with corpus minimization, sanitizer integration, dictionaries and custom mutators.
sources.limits: Original authors no longer add major features; narrow deterministic fast targets are important for efficiency.

sources.title: Uncertainty Quantification and Confidence Calibration in Large Language Models: A Survey
sources.evidence_notes: Surveys LLM uncertainty across input, reasoning, parameter and prediction dimensions and discusses efficiency/applicability tradeoffs.
sources.limits: Survey results span heterogeneous tasks/models and do not imply one universal metric.

sources.title: Uncertainty of Thoughts: Uncertainty-Aware Planning Enhances Information Seeking in Large Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Uses scenario simulation and information-gain-style uncertainty rewards to choose follow-up questions; reported higher task success and question efficiency across multiple interactive tasks/models.
sources.limits: Simulation quality and uncertainty estimate can be wrong; medical examples do not justify clinical use.

sources.title: KLEE: Unassisted and Automatic Generation of High-Coverage Tests for Complex Systems Programs
sources.evidence_notes: Symbolically executes program paths and uses constraint solving to generate high-coverage tests; found longstanding real bugs in mature utilities.
sources.limits: Path explosion and environment modeling constrain scale.

sources.title: AddressSanitizer: A Fast Address Sanity Checker
sources.evidence_notes: Compiler instrumentation detects out-of-bounds/use-after-free errors at runtime with practical overhead and has found many production bugs.
sources.limits: Primarily native-memory bugs; not directly relevant to pure Python unless native extensions are involved.

sources.title: CodeQL Documentation
sources.evidence_notes: Queries code as data to identify vulnerability patterns across supported languages; current documentation includes security/quality query suites.
sources.limits: Static analysis has false positives/coverage limits and only supports specific languages/frameworks.

sources.title: Software testing with QuickCheck
sources.evidence_notes: Property-based generators and state-machine models test broad input/state spaces rather than fixed examples.
sources.limits: Quality depends on properties/generators and generated cases may miss semantically important regions.

sources.title: Semantic Entropy for Hallucination Detection
sources.evidence_notes: Clusters sampled answers by semantic meaning and estimates entropy over meanings; reported stronger detection of confabulations than several baselines across tasks/models.
sources.limits: Requires multiple samples/semantic clustering and only targets uncertainty-driven confabulation, not systematic confidently wrong answers.

sources.title: A Tutorial on Thompson Sampling
sources.evidence_notes: Broad treatment of posterior-sampling approaches to sequential exploration/exploitation across recommendation, active learning, shortest paths and RL.
sources.limits: Online exploration can be inappropriate when interventions have meaningful user/safety cost.

sources.title: Learning from Time-Changing Data with Adaptive Windowing (ADWIN)
sources.evidence_notes: Adaptive window size responds to detected change with statistical false-positive/negative guarantees under assumptions.
sources.limits: Scalar/stream statistics and assumptions may not capture high-dimensional semantic drift directly.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-226: Guidelines for Evaluating Differential Privacy Guarantees
sources.evidence_notes: 2025 final NIST guidance for evaluating DP claims, utility/bias tradeoffs and implementation hazards, including ML applications.
sources.limits: DP protects participation/privacy under a specified mechanism; it does not make raw sensitive processing or outputs inherently safe.

sources.title: Thompson Sampling for Contextual Bandit Problems with Auxiliary Safety Constraints
sources.evidence_notes: Contextual Thompson sampling variant incorporates multiple outcome/safety constraints relative to policy objectives.
sources.limits: Empirical/theoretical setting does not automatically translate to human-notification or personal-assistant harms.

sources.title: OpenAI Responses API create reference
sources.evidence_notes: Current Responses API reference exposes model-dependent temperature/top_p/logprobs and operational controls including max_output_tokens, max_tool_calls and truncation behavior.
sources.limits: Capabilities/parameters are model dependent and evolve.

sources.title: OpenAI Token Counting
sources.evidence_notes: Current token-counting docs explain exact input counting and that output budgets include non-visible reasoning/formatting tokens, requiring headroom.
sources.limits: Provider-specific accounting.

sources.title: Guidance: A Language for Controlling Large Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Interleaves deterministic Python control with model generation and supports regex/CFG/JSON-schema constrained generation plus token fast-forwarding.
sources.limits: Framework abstraction and backend integration add maintenance; semantic correctness still requires validators.

sources.title: MIPRO: Optimizing Instructions and Demonstrations for Multi-Stage Language Model Programs
sources.evidence_notes: Jointly optimizes instructions and demonstrations across multi-stage LM programs using downstream metrics/surrogate search; reported gains on most studied programs.
sources.limits: Optimizer can overfit development metric and costs many evaluations.

sources.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
sources.evidence_notes: Uses trajectory reflection and Pareto/genetic search to evolve prompts; reported large gains with fewer rollouts than GRPO on studied tasks.
sources.limits: Recent method; reflection can mutate crucial constraints and holdout governance is essential.

sources.title: RAG-Fusion
sources.evidence_notes: Generates multiple query perspectives and fuses ranked lists via reciprocal rank fusion for broader retrieval.
sources.limits: Small/manual evaluation and query drift risk.

sources.title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation (CRAG)
sources.evidence_notes: Retrieval evaluator triggers corrective retrieval actions, web extension, and selective document decomposition/recomposition.
sources.limits: Quality depends on evaluator; web expansion increases trust/injection surface.

sources.title: Adaptive-RAG
sources.evidence_notes: Routes queries among no-retrieval, single-step and iterative retrieval based on predicted complexity.
sources.limits: Complexity is only a proxy for evidence need; classifier may not transfer.
