sources.title: Query2doc: Query Expansion with Large Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: LLM-generated pseudo-documents expand queries and improved sparse/dense retrieval in original experiments.
sources.limits: Fabricated pseudo-document details can bias retrieval.

sources.title: RankGPT / Is ChatGPT Good at Search?
sources.evidence_notes: Permutation-style LLM passage reranking was competitive with strong supervised rankers; ranking behavior was also distilled into a smaller model.
sources.limits: High inference cost and positional/order biases require controls.

sources.title: ColPali: Efficient Document Retrieval with Vision Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Retrieves visually rich document pages directly with vision-language multi-vector embeddings and late interaction.
sources.limits: Visual retrieval does not replace extraction/OCR where exact field values are needed; index is expensive.

sources.title: Compacter: Efficient Low-Rank Hypercomplex Adapter Layers
sources.evidence_notes: Highly parameter-efficient hypercomplex adapter architecture reported competitive or better results with very small trainable fraction.
sources.limits: Older model regime and higher implementation complexity.

sources.title: DoRA: Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation
sources.evidence_notes: Separates weight magnitude and direction, applying low-rank updates to direction; reported stronger quality/stability than LoRA across several tasks.
sources.limits: Requires local training and exact-task revalidation.

sources.title: VeRA: Vector-based Random Matrix Adaptation
sources.evidence_notes: Shares frozen random low-rank matrices and learns only scaling vectors, greatly reducing per-task trainable/storage parameters.
sources.limits: Quality depends on task/model/random basis.

sources.title: NEFTune: Noisy Embeddings Improve Instruction Finetuning
sources.evidence_notes: Embedding noise during fine-tuning produced large gains in original instruction-tuning experiments without extra data.
sources.limits: Authors note judge bias, limited large-model validation, fixed hyperparameters and unclear mechanism.

sources.title: Editing Models with Task Arithmetic
sources.evidence_notes: Fine-tune weight deltas can be added/subtracted to compose/suppress capabilities across compatible models.
sources.limits: Nonlinear interference and scale sensitivity require broad evaluation.

sources.title: Language Models are Super Mario / DARE
sources.evidence_notes: Randomly drops/rescales fine-tuning deltas and merges homologous models; reported strong capability composition without retraining.
sources.limits: Aggressive delta sparsification can cause hidden regressions and results depend on compatible models.

sources.title: ShortGPT: Layers in Large Language Models are More Redundant Than You Expect
sources.evidence_notes: Block-influence metric identifies low-impact transformer blocks for structured layer removal with reported strong compression.
sources.limits: Low average influence does not imply low importance on rare capabilities.

sources.title: Compact Language Models via Pruning and Knowledge Distillation (Minitron)
sources.evidence_notes: Systematic structured width/depth/attention/MLP pruning plus distillation produced smaller models with large training-token savings.
sources.limits: Requires significant retraining and exact model/task replication.

sources.title: Mixture-of-Depths
sources.evidence_notes: Learns token-wise routing through transformer blocks under fixed compute budget and reported faster sampling at matched performance/FLOPs.
sources.limits: Training architecture and serving changes required.

sources.title: H2O: Heavy-Hitter Oracle for Efficient Generative Inference
sources.evidence_notes: Retains recent and high-attention heavy-hitter tokens while evicting others; reported substantial KV-memory/throughput gains.
sources.limits: Attention-importance policy can discard details needed later; workload/model dependent.

sources.title: Scissorhands: KV Cache Compression at Test Time
sources.evidence_notes: Uses persistence-of-importance to retain pivotal KV entries and reported strong KV compression.
sources.limits: Heuristic may fail when previously low-attention tokens become important.

sources.title: StreamingLLM: Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks
sources.evidence_notes: Keeps initial attention-sink tokens plus recent rolling window to enable stable streaming with bounded cache.
sources.limits: Not equivalent to random-access long context; old content is discarded from KV.

sources.title: LongLoRA
sources.evidence_notes: Shifted short attention during fine-tuning with LoRA reduces long-context adaptation cost while using dense attention at inference.
sources.limits: Model-specific training/inference tradeoffs.

sources.title: Ring Attention with Blockwise Transformers for Near-Infinite Context
sources.evidence_notes: Distributes sequence blocks across devices in a ring and overlaps attention computation with KV communication.
sources.limits: Multi-device complexity and total attention computation remain substantial.

sources.title: Landmark Attention: Random-Access Infinite Context Length for Transformers
sources.evidence_notes: Landmark tokens learn to route attention to relevant context blocks for long-range random access.
sources.limits: Requires training/model modification and is less auditable than external retrieval.

sources.title: WebArena
sources.evidence_notes: Reproducible realistic web environments with execution-based functional evaluation for long-horizon agents.
sources.limits: Rehosted websites do not fully reproduce live-web drift/security.

sources.title: OSWorld
sources.evidence_notes: Real desktop applications/OS with execution-based evaluators for multimodal computer-use agents.
sources.limits: Benchmark task/app distribution differs from a user's real desktop.

sources.title: AssistantBench
sources.evidence_notes: Realistic time-consuming web assistant tasks exposed low precision/hallucination and weak open-web agent performance in early systems.
sources.limits: Small/rapidly aging benchmark relative to agent progress.

sources.title: AgentBench
sources.evidence_notes: Multi-environment benchmark exposes long-horizon reasoning/decision/instruction-following weaknesses across interactive environments.
sources.limits: Older model/scaffold generation and abstract task mix.

sources.title: ProgPrompt: Generating Situated Robot Task Plans using Large Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Program-like action/object specifications and examples constrain plans to executable action space.
sources.limits: Embodied domain and older model regime.

sources.title: Inner Monologue: Embodied Reasoning through Planning with Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Structured environment feedback, perception and success detection improve closed-loop embodied planning.
sources.limits: Robot-specific evidence; feedback quality remains the limiting oracle.
